headword: {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}

definitions.explanation: An exam taken to gain admission to a school, typically for middle school, high school, or university.

examples.japanese: {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare for the entrance exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The university entrance exam is next month.

notes:
{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん} is often abbreviated as ⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧ in everyday conversation.

FORMS:
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ (entering school) + ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (examination)

TYPES OF ENTRANCE EXAMS:
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧: high school entrance exam
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧: university entrance exam
- ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: Common Test (standardized university exam)
- ⟦{推薦|すいせん}→推薦：03358_suisen⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧: recommendation-based admission
- AO⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧: admission office (interview-based)
